With a two-engine Cessna 340A and the passion for aviation the foundation was laid for a successful company that has existed for over 20 years. In the year 2005 the fleet was expanded by a Citation ISP in which up to 7 passengers can comfortably sit. Since 2016 the Eclipse 550 can transport a maximum of 3 passengers comfortably through the airspace. The Eclipse combines the comfort and safety of a jet for business flights in the world's lovingly-described smallest private jet.
